entries.text: This scan found 30 issues across 5 pages, and all of them are critical or serious (7 critical, 23 serious). Fix the social icon links in the shared footer template first (src/Shell.jsx): they wrap icons only and carry no text name, so screen readers announce nothing for them on every page — one fix there clears all 15. Next, the muted grey footer text (p.muted) is too faint against white to read reliably; darkening that one style clears 5 more.
